source_refs.note: 5. Paint Sprayer: a main subheading of 5.12 Uses of Bernoulli's principle, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Liquid mein doobi tube ke oopar se hawa ki dhaar guzre to liquid tube mein oopar charh jata hai (Fig. 5.21). Yeh asar perfume ki botlon aur paint sprayers mein istemal hota hai. Atomizer ki rubber ki gend dabane se hawa tube mein se tez speed se patle munh (aperture) se nikalti hai aur wahan pressure gir jata hai. Is liye bahar ka atmospheric pressure perfume ko dhakel kar oopar patle munh tak le aata hai.

blocks.alt: Neela teer Air ko ek line mein dakhil hota dikhata hai jo daen taraf Nozzle tak tang hoti hai. Nozzle se ek khari tube laal Paint ke bartan mein doobi hai; laal teer paint ko tube mein oopar uthta aur nozzle se phuhaar (spray) bante dikhate hain. Neele teer bartan ke andar paint ki surface par neeche dabate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.21: Liquid mein doobi tube ke oopar se guzarti hawa ki dhaar (kitab ki Figure 5.21 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nozzle par hawa bohat tez hai, is liye tube ke oopar pressure kam ho jata hai. Paint ki surface par hawa ka pressure (neele teer) zyada hai; yahi pressure paint ko tube mein oopar dhakelta hai. Paint kheencha nahi jata, dhakela jata hai.
